notes_for_editor: Thin sourcing: the register is the only detailed source and it says construction year and height are unknown. Search results also return the 'Clevedon Lookout Tower' (the Sugar Lookout) in Clevedon, Somerset, England; those pages are unrelated and were not used. The 1958 Cleveland fire tower reference may or may not be this structure; left unresolved in the story. No staffing, access or visit source found; none recorded. No photos added; the NHLR page credits Brian Ziegler but gives no image URL.
